title: Create templates and localization updates
summary: Work with Velocity templates, generate checked localization SQL across releases, and bring more reliable validation to Quick Query imports.
notes: Velocity Template renders Text or JSON from editable Context Data, reports syntax and runtime errors, and can validate against the configured API.
On Desktop, import a Velocity template from Oracle and create a Quick Query update draft from its source fields.
Lockey Update validates localization rows and generates Oracle INSERT SQL for up to four release targets, with post-update inspection queries.
Load localization history from Oracle, filter by key or release, and see which English or Indonesian values changed.
Quick Query preserves typed and BLOB import values and CONFIG_IDs, improves Oracle import errors, and warns about attachments over 300 KB.
HTML Template preserves unusual line separators through text import and export, and names them in encoding review.
Registration adds Bank Mandiri profile details and OTP-first verification with manual-approval fallback; analytics, mobile, and Desktop workflows also improved.

slides.title: Preview and validate Velocity templates
slides.body: Edit a Velocity template and its JSON Context Data side by side. The local preview updates as you work; Validate sends the inputs to your configured Velocity API.
bullets: Switch the rendered result between Text and JSON.
Review syntax and runtime diagnostics with source locations, or use Add missing fields to review suggested context changes before applying them.
Desktop can import a template from Oracle and create a Quick Query update draft from its fields.

slides.title: Build localization update SQL
slides.body: Lockey Update checks localization rows and release targets, then creates an Oracle script for review and use in your existing database workflow.
bullets: Add up to four release targets and enter the English and Indonesian values for each localization key.
Resolve validation messages and inspect the generated INSERT statements before copying or downloading the script.
Load history from Oracle to filter saved versions and review changed language values; the script also includes post-update inspection queries.

slides.title: Keep imported data intact in Quick Query
slides.body: Recent Quick Query changes make import and update workflows easier to review while preserving important source values.
bullets: Excel imports align with schema fields and preserve typed spreadsheet values.
Oracle import errors now include clearer messages and details; BLOB imports retain their placeholders.
Attachments larger than 300 KB show a warning before query generation.

tips.title: New Feature: Lockey Update
tips.body: Add release targets and localization values, then copy the validated Oracle update script.

tips.title: New Feature: Velocity Template
tips.body: Edit VTL with JSON Context Data, preview locally, then validate against your configured API.

tips.title: Validate with your configured API
tips.body: The preview updates as you edit; choose Validate to send the template and Context Data to the configured Velocity API.

tips.title: Generate a localization update script
tips.body: Add release targets and localization values, then use Copy after validation passes to take the generated SQL into your Oracle review workflow.
